{
  "name": "krci-triage",
  "version": "0.5.1",
  "description": "KubeRocketCI testbed and workspace toolkit - provision the source workspace and a try-kuberocketci testbed, then diagnose, reproduce, fix, and verify code changes on the cluster, including end-to-end Jira-tracked issue triage, plus opt-in krci-kubelock, which locks kubectl, helm and every script Claude runs to the testbed context",
  "author": {
    "name": "KubeRocketCI Team",
    "email": "support@kuberocketci.io"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/KubeRocketCI/claude-plugins",
  "repository": "https://github.com/KubeRocketCI/claude-plugins",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "kuberocketci",
    "triage",
    "bugfix",
    "jira",
    "testbed",
    "try-kuberocketci",
    "kind",
    "workspace",
    "reproduce",
    "verify",
    "e2e",
    "krci-kubelock",
    "kubeconfig"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "kubelock": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "krci-kubelock",
      "description": "Lock kubectl, helm and every script Claude runs to the krci-kubelock context; block commands that target any other context. Recommended: on.",
      "default": false
    },
    "kubelockContext": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "krci-kubelock context",
      "description": "The only kube context Claude may use while krci-kubelock is on",
      "default": "kind-krci"
    }
  }
}
